options.label: SQLite (embedded)
options.description: One machine, one process, zero administration. ACID with WAL journaling.

options.label: Postgres
options.description: Several machines on a LAN sharing one dataset. Required for lan-server mode.
notes: Set SIMBKIT_DATABASE_URL on each client, and build with SIMBKIT_DATABASE=postgres.
Postgres must be reachable from every client — usually the machine running lan-server mode.

options.label: Standalone
options.description: One machine, no sockets opened at all.

options.label: LAN server
options.description: One instance serves the others on the local network. Needs Postgres.
notes: Build with SIMBKIT_MODE=lan-server. SQLite over a network share corrupts — use --database postgres.

options.label: Cloud sync
options.description: Local database plus an outbox that syncs when a server is reachable.
notes: Build with SIMBKIT_MODE=cloud-sync and decide the conflict policy before the first deployment.
